0022600209.text: The San Antonio Spurs come into this game 7-2 overall, on a seven-game winning streak, and 3-0 on the road, while the Phoenix Suns are 3-5 with a two-game winning streak and sit 12th in the West. The Spurs are without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and the Suns are without Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery). The teams have not met yet this season, after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, and their last meeting was a 101-100 Spurs win in San Antonio on March 19, 2026.
